thesis: The episode explores the unconventional background of Mike Trigg, who fell in love with investing in college and joined the Motley Fool as a writer at age 22 after graduating in 2000. The conversation covers his experience writing articles during the internet euphoria, the subsequent layoffs at the company, and his transition to becoming a partner and portfolio manager at WCM.
